title: positionBody adds the applies-by-word section, playbook cells and mandates, and reserves blocking rules by word
summary: @inventarch/runtime's positionBody, and so position, adds four sections to the ia.position-body.v1 body, whose format name is unchanged: appliesByWord, appliesByWordTallies, cells and mandates, after pointerTallies; counts gains appliesByWord and truncatedAppliesByWord. The AppliesByWord, PositionCell and SubjectMatch types are exported from the package root and @inventarch/runtime/internal/position, and PositionVia gains a subject variant, {by: 'subject', label: 'field match, not a row', matches}. appliesByWord lists the `@law`, `@convention`, `@principle` and `@playbook` records of the seat's closure whose unconditionally stated subject.subject-word is the word, or subject.subject-kind the kind, of a loaded record, the seat included, or of a blocking candidate reserved in rules, which the body delivers in full as it does a loaded record; nothing applies by word to a rule that rules holds by word alone. That is a field match: it follows no row and claims no relation. Each record is listed once, at hop 0, with every field that matches and the first loaded or reserved record answering it, and with its re-seat key {seat, shape, phase, depth: 1, budget: 16}, ranked by band descending then identity; the first 48 are listed and the rest tallied per word and owner system. An entry may also be loaded or a pointer. rules now also holds every blocking `@law`, `@convention` or `@principle` other than the seat that applies by word to a candidate, whichever candidates the budget truncates, so a blocking rule is delivered at budget 0 whether it applies by claim, by row or by word, and no entry of rules is in appliesByWord, pointers or the frontier. cells gives, for the first four playbooks in appliesByWord, the cell at the key's phase and the shape's primitive as {playbook, address, text}, address being <identity>#<phase>/<Primitive> and text what ia read reads at that address; a playbook without one gives {playbook, missing, nearest?, message}, nearest being the closest phase with a cell of that primitive in the cycle orient, plan, act, learn, a tie going to the phase that order lists first. The phase changes only the cells and the keys spelled with it. mandates lists the `@mandate` records of the closure that claim a location seat or whose authority.scope names the seat's workspace, each once and at hop 0, a mandate that does both keeping its claim, by band descending then identity. With a word set, the four sections list records of that word only, and no record at runtime placement enters them. Limits: a cell's condition is not evaluated, so every cell at the address is delivered; no mandate is matched by its participant; and an `@agent` record's governance.applies is not read.
